documents.title: Transformer
documents.content:
# Architecture
The Transformer replaces recurrence with multi-head self-attention. Positional encoding preserves token order.

# Training
The original model uses an Adam optimizer and a warmup learning-rate schedule.

documents.title: BERT
documents.content:
# Pretraining
BERT learns bidirectional representations with masked language modeling and next sentence prediction.

# Evaluation
It is fine-tuned for question answering and classification tasks.

documents.title: RAG
documents.content:
# Method
Retrieval-augmented generation combines a parametric generator with non-parametric retrieved documents. The retriever supplies evidence passages to generation.

documents.title: LoRA
documents.content:
# Efficient tuning
LoRA freezes pretrained weights and injects trainable low-rank matrices. It reduces the number of trainable parameters for adaptation.

documents.title: ReAct
documents.content:
# Agent reasoning
ReAct interleaves reasoning traces with actions and observations. Tool feedback lets the agent revise its next action.

documents.title: BM25
documents.content:
# Lexical ranking
BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and document-length normalization. It is effective for exact terminology.

documents.title: DPR
documents.content:
# Dense retrieval
Dense Passage Retrieval uses separate question and passage encoders. Similarity in embedding space retrieves semantically related passages.

documents.title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion
documents.content:
# Rank fusion
Reciprocal Rank Fusion combines multiple ranked lists using reciprocal rank scores. It does not require score calibration between retrievers.

documents.title: Agent memory
documents.content:
# Memory tiers
Working memory tracks the active task. Short-term memory stores recent dialogue. Long-term memory keeps stable knowledge across sessions.

documents.title: Citation evaluation
documents.content:
# Grounded answers
Citation precision measures whether cited evidence supports a claim. Citation recall measures whether important claims have supporting citations.
